# ”Fortsätter de kompensera så här bra är det försiktigt positivt”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon's 15 October 2026 episode covered the start of the Q3 reporting season while markets were nervous: Wall Street fell on hot US September inflation, and AI-bubble worries came back after CoreWeave's slide. Ericsson stood out with a strong earnings beat under its new CEO, and the hosts called it cautiously positive. Nordea's results were in line, but its paused buybacks were seen as negative for the stock, following SEB's sharp fall on capital requirements. Kinnevik (new CEO, large cash pile, wide discount) and AQ Group (data-centre exposure) were flagged as reports to watch. VAT Group's order surge showed that underlying AI and data-centre build-out demand is still strong.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Clear Q3 beat; hosts say continued ability to offset component costs is cautiously positive, but guidance not offensive.

#### Reasoning

Sales of 59.5bn vs 55.4bn expected and 7% organic growth, with cost discipline carrying the beat through to profit. The hosts say that if Ericsson keeps offsetting component cost inflation this well, the view is cautiously positive. The outlook stays cautious, though: the RAN market is flat and has no underlying growth. The new CEO's restructuring is evolutionary rather than revolutionary.

#### Sell Triggers

- if component cost inflation can no longer be passed on to customers
- if RAN market weakens from flat
- if management reshuffle disrupts execution

> *"Utan kan han fortsätta kompensera så här bra så är det nog försiktigt positivt."*

---

### 🟡 NDA-SE — Nordea | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

In-line quarter, but buyback pause pending ECB/REA clarification is not share-positive.

#### Reasoning

The core numbers (NII and revenues) were in line. Part of the investment case is high yield plus buybacks, and the buyback pause takes away a support. Capital is retained rather than lost. The move looks proactive ahead of model adjustments, unlike SEB's reactive regulatory hit, so the hosts' view is neutral-to-negative in the short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if ECB REA clarification implies prolonged buyback halt
- if dividend capacity is reduced

> *"Den här pausen var förmodligen väntad, men det är inte aktiepositivt."*

---

### 🟠 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

New CEO's first report; plan for ~5bn cash could narrow large discount, creating double effect with market.

#### Reasoning

The market has priced in a turnaround as US tech holdings bottom out. The key catalyst is a credible capital-allocation plan for the roughly 5bn net cash without panic buys. Combined with a market recovery, that could narrow the large NAV discount and give a double effect on the share.

#### Sell Triggers

- if CEO presents no clear plan for the cash
- if cash is deployed in hasty/panic acquisitions
- if US tech portfolio valuations fall again

> *"Med den här stora rabatten de har, så om man kan få förtroende för den väg de har framåt nu så skulle de kunna få ner rabatten ytterligare."*

---

### 🟠 AQ — AQ Group | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Rides data-centre build-out, strong share performance into report; early industrial reporter.

#### Reasoning

AQ Group is a contract manufacturer exposed to data-centre build-out. Its last report went very well and the shares have done well into this one. As one of the first industrials to report, it may give hints about the engineering sector. The hosts flag the report as something to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre order momentum slows
- if report disappoints after strong run-up

> *"Lite mindre men också ett bolag som rider på den här utbyggnaden av datacenter."*

---

### ⛔ SEB-A — SEB | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell 5-6% on higher FI capital requirements; distributions delayed to end of next year at earliest; market impatient.

#### Reasoning

Finansinspektionen's tougher requirements delay buybacks and extra distributions until end of next year at the earliest. The capital is not lost, but the market is impatient, which weighs on the share in the near term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if FI requirements are eased or clarified earlier than expected

> *"Men i SEBs fall så handlar det om slutet på nästa år som de skulle komma tillbaka tidigast. Så aktiemarknaden är otålig."*
